purpose: One notification presentation for inline messages and floating lifecycle-managed feedback.
behaviorProvider: Native notice presentation; NotificationViewport/showNotification delegate floating lifecycle to Sonner.

component: Default inline destroy to alert, floating or loading to status, and other inline notices to note. An explicit role can override this; presentation/none clears labeling and live metadata.
Render a decorative intent icon unless icon is null/false. Associate an optional title; expose real button actions and a named dismiss button only when callbacks are provided.
host: Mount a viewport for floating service calls and choose notification urgency, duration and deduplication.
Own action failures and async lifecycle. Update/dismiss loading messages explicitly; do not use transient notices as the only record of important errors.

requirements.statement: Default inline destroy to alert, floating or loading to status, and other inline notices to note. An explicit role can override this; presentation/none clears labeling and live metadata.
Render a decorative intent icon unless icon is null/false. Associate an optional title; expose real button actions and a named dismiss button only when callbacks are provided.

Notification alone has no timer or queue. showNotification uses a custom Sonner item; loading duration is infinite until replaced by id or dismissed. Its custom body is presentational so Sonner owns notification semantics.
NotificationViewport defaults to bottom-right and four visible toasts with token-backed spacing. showNotification wraps its single action to dismiss after the synchronous callback.
Mount a viewport for floating service calls and choose notification urgency, duration and deduplication.
Own action failures and async lifecycle. Update/dismiss loading messages explicitly; do not use transient notices as the only record of important errors.

Use feedback group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: Inline presentation does not persist or auto-dismiss itself. Custom action slots own their own lifecycle.
Banner/Callout adapt inline Notification; Toast/Toaster/showToast are compatibility adapters, not distinct behavioral engines.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
